name: Uma Chakravarti
shortBio: Indian feminist historian and social theorist who formulated the concept of Brahmanical patriarchy, analyzing how caste hierarchy and control over women’s sexuality co-constitute social stratification in South Asia.
centralQuestion: How do caste endogamy, gendered sexual regulation, and sacred textual authority interlock to reproduce Brahmanical patriarchy?

keyWorks.title: Conceptualising Brahmanical Patriarchy in Early India
keyWorks.description: Seminal theoretical essay demonstrating that caste reproduction depends structurally on policing women’s sexuality and labor.

keyWorks.title: Gendering Caste: Through a Feminist Lens
keyWorks.description: Synthesizes Ambedkarite anti-caste critique with feminist historiography to examine graded inequality.
